title: FP8 onboarding orchestrator and shadow-batch sentry for E4M3/E5M2 on Hopper
creator: Samantha Lee
description: Build an "onboarding orchestrator" that coordinates profile calibration, shadow-batch validation, and safety gating for FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) on Hopper GPUs. This ticket covers the controller logic, calibration job workflows, per-shard hysteresis, and a non-invasive shadow execution path that runs customer traffic through FP8 candidates without affecting production responses. The goal is to safely expand FP8 coverage across model families with automated rollback and telemetry gating.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can schedule and monitor calibration jobs for a model variant with E4M3 and E5M2 candidate profiles
Shadow-batch path executes at <=5% additional tail latency and can be toggled per-route via config
Gating rules reject activation if regression in top-level metrics (perplexity/EM/semantic similarity) exceeds thresholds defined in the policy
Automated rollback and audit logs for every profile activation attempt with root-cause hints
Telemetry surface includes per-layer dynamic scale histograms, cross-batch variance, and a stability score used for rollout decisions
calibration_workflow: Step 1: Launch calibration job against golden seed set (1000 prompts covering long-tail tokens)
Step 2: Collect per-layer scale factors and outlier ratios, compute candidate E4M3/E5M2 profiles
Step 3: Run synthetic shadow-batch across recent production traffic subset (1% sample) with prefix caching enabled
Step 4: Compute accuracy deltas (EM, BLEU, embedding-similarity) and token-level divergence metrics
Step 5: Apply hysteresis policy: require stability over 6-hour sliding window before canary
Step 6: Canary with live traffic at 0.5% -> 2% -> 5% with automatic abort on metric drift
validation_plan: Golden inference baseline created per model-version; do not retrain baseline within a validation cycle
Metric set: token-levenshtein, normalized embedding cosine, generation-coherence score, latency P50/P95/P99
Define pass thresholds: embedding sim >= 0.995 for dense tasks, generation-coherence drop <= 0.8% for NLG tasks
Run end-to-end A/B pass/fail test harness with seeded RNGs to detect flakiness
Small-model synthetic perturbation tests to exercise extreme FP8 dynamic ranges
Post-canary daily regression sweep for 7 days before wide activation
telemetry_requirements: Expose per-token Q-error counters and per-layer scale histograms to metrics backend
Add drift-sentry that computes KL divergence across consecutive 1M-token windows
Tag every shadow request with profile_id, job_id, and sample_seed for auditability
Add rollout dashboard widget: stability_score, error_budget_consumption, and rollback_reasons
rollout_plan: Internal dev-run: onboarding orchestrator deployed to staging, run calibrations on 3 representative models
Shadow traffic run for two weeks against staging and one small internal prod route
Canary stage gating via Console feature flag: start at 0.5% for 24h, then 2% for 48h, then 5% for 72h
If canary passes, schedule incremental population of Dedicated pools with FP8-allowed models
Document activation in release notes and notify support/CS about possible customer-facing changes
risks_mitigation: Risk: silent semantic regressions not caught by numeric thresholds -> Mitigation: include human v-sampled reviews for first 20 canaries
Risk: FP8 overflow/underflow on rare tokens -> Mitigation: per-layer outlier detection and auto-fallback to INT8 on affected shards
Risk: increased tail-latency due to shadow execution -> Mitigation: bounded worker pool, best-effort scheduling and dynamic shed rate
Risk: calibration job resource spike -> Mitigation: quota throttle and backoff, and leverage off-peak windows for heavy sweeps
